text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick heads up : guest showing up at 11:15 — Lucia from Velocity. Delivery note says 'box + welcome kit' but badge for Lucia is missing in the stack. Anyone spot an extra visitor badge?
Front Desk (Bot): Package logged: 1x box, 1x welcome kit for Lucia. Badge not found in print queue.
Eli: I printed a bunch this morning for the workshop; could have grabbed it by mistake. Where are extras kept?
Marcus: There's a spare sheet in the mailroom drawer labeled 'Visitor Badges' next to the label maker.
Nora (People Ops): Can someone check the drawer and if not there, we can print a single badge at the desk. Also need to reserve Quiet Room 1 at 11:15 for a 30 min intro.
Dana: I'll check drawer now.
Eli: Sorry team, I did take a sheet earlier for the workshop but left an empty stack on the printer tray. If there's no badge, I can run back and print one.
Front Desk (Bot): Quiet Room 1 availability: free 11:15-11:45. Reservation created upon request.
Dana: Drawer checked, no badge with Lucia name. I found blank visitor stickers and a badge clip.
Marcus: Please reserve the room, Nora. I'll meet guest at lobby and handle the kit.
Nora (People Ops): Reserving Quiet Room 1 now and adding "Lucia (Velocity)" to the board. Also note: welcome kit contains a laptop sticker sheet  and a water bottle (fragile label applied).
Eli: Printing single badge now and will leave on the desk with "Lucia" sticky note.
Front Desk (Bot): Badge printed and placed at Front Desk. Package moved to holding locker #4. Escort assigned: Marcus.
Marcus: On my way to lobby. Will escort and leave the kit in the room.
Nora (People Ops): Thanks all! Small follow-up: can whoever used the badge sheets please update the supply log (we're down two sheets).
Eli: Will update supply log and reorder if low. Sorry for the scramble :sweat_smile:
